name: WILLIAM PETERS
abstract_title: The Shared Death Experience:  A Compelling End-of-Life Phenomenon that Suggests the Continuation of Consciousness Beyond Human Death
abstract: The shared death experience (SDE) is gaining recognition as a notable end-of-life phenomenon that raises questions about conventional materialist views of consciousness and the nature of dying. In SDEs, individuals report sensing or participating in another person’s passage from life to a postmortem state.
